edits.value_json: “Half” is the established current meaning and appears in historical examples, including the cited bronze numeral use 大半升. One proposal treats “half” as an extension of “split/open”; another treats “half” as the original meaning. The evidence does not settle the disagreement.
Historical examples document use for a middle part or point in time or space. A proposal derives this use from dividing an object, but its chronology and relation to “half” are unresolved.

The proposed starting points conflict: “split/open” may have developed into “half,” or “half” may have been original. A separate proposal derives “middle” and “incomplete” from dividing an object; it does not establish that either developed from the lexical sense “half.” No dated sequence or half-to-midpoint/partial lexical path is established. Historical examples document midpoint, partial or incomplete, and “very little,” but do not establish chronological links among these meanings.
